subject: Human Body
title: The Pituitary: Master Gland
description: One-minute skill: The Pituitary: Master Gland.

hook.text: The pituitary is pea-sized but produces hormones that control growth, reproduction, and metabolism.

buildup.text: It has two lobes. The anterior lobe makes growth hormone, TSH, ACTH, and gonadotropins.

discovery.text: The pituitary acts on command from the hypothalamus.

twist.text: Pituitary tumors can cause overproduction of growth hormone.

climax.text: The pituitary is a relay station. It takes orders from the brain and broadcasts them to glands across the body.

punchline.text: Pea-sized gland, body-wide authority. That's the pituitary.

quiz.question: What can a pituitary tumor cause?
options: Permanent loss of all hormone production
Overproduction of growth hormone, leading to acromegaly
Immediate shutdown of the thyroid gland
